component.name: Penzene
component.summary: Draw chemical structures and reaction schemes

description.p: Penzene is an open-source chemical structure editor for drawing molecules, reaction schemes and publication figures quickly, with the mouse or the keyboard.

ul.li: Fast drawing: point at an atom and type to add bonds, rings, groups and labels
Live formula and mass, stereo labels, structure checks and a properties panel
ACS, RSC and JDP drawing styles; reaction arrows, electron pushing, templates
SVG, PNG and PDF export that reopens as an editable drawing
MOL, SDF, SMILES, InChI, RXN and CDXML files
